conviction_note: Q1 (OP 7.9bn, +40.5%) plus a Q2 read from the monthlies (OP ~2.9-3.9bn against 2.37bn last year) puts H1 OP near 11bn, about 65% of a 17.2bn FY guide that now implies H2 OP down ~35% YoY. That makes an upward revision more likely than not, but consensus (19.4bn ordinary) already expects one and this name sold a 19% Q1 beat by -2.7%. So the +1.5 finding goes out as +1.2. The stock has de-rated ~10% into the print, unlike before Q1, and that is the only reason the sign is kept positive.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit is tracking ~11bn (Q1 actual 7,875m plus a Q2 estimate of 2.9-3.9bn), about 63-68% of the unchanged 17.2bn FY guide. The guide therefore implies H2 OP of ~6bn against 8.55bn last year. The company raised its FY guide at H1 the last time it ran this far ahead (2023-09-29, OP 14.0->18.0bn), so an upward revision at this print is more likely than not. The Q2 estimate comes from the TDnet monthly: parent-company Q2 sales +0.9%, same-store -0.8%, customers -2.2%, but same-store ticket +1.5% (Aug +4.0%), which is the markdown-restraint pattern that lifted Q1 gross margin +1.3pt against a Q2 last year at ~53.7% GM / 3.3% OP margin after inventory clearance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 (2026-06-30): OP +40.5%, ordinary 8.05bn vs ~6.75bn consensus, guide held -> next session -2.74% after a +5.6% two-day run-in (kabutan n202607010368, '織り込み済み'). H1 FY2026 (2025-09-30): H1 ordinary -24%, below consensus, guide held -> -7.61% (baseline; Nikkei DGXZQOFL010T00R01C25A0000000). H1 FY2025 (2024-09-30): guide held at 19.0bn -> +6.45% (baseline, estimated date). The last H1 raise, 2023-09-29 (kabuyoho revision history), is outside the baseline window.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at 19.4bn ordinary already assumes a raise, so the revision is only partly news. What is not in the price is the stock holding that view: before Q1 it ran +5.6% in two days and sat at 3,460-3,525, but it has now fallen from 3,555 (08-26) to 3,065, ~4-5pt worse than apparel peers after the dividend, while consensus rose 2.3% on 09-10 and the average target is 3,557. At 13.5x company EPS the stock is trading as though the guide will be held, or Q2 will disappoint on the June -6.2% same-store month. If the raise were priced it would sit near the pre-Q1 level, not 14% below it.
findings.independence: Same fundamental read, separate source: the kabuyoho/IFIS consensus rose from 18,925m to 19,375m on 2026-09-10 (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=2685), and a Nikkei 2026-09-05 headline has a director citing reduced markdown sales (https://www.nikkei.com/nkd/company/news/?scode=2685, headline only, paywalled). Against it: Shimamura's Jun-Aug OP margin fell 9.2%->8.7% and its FY guide was held on 2026-09-28 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8227&b=k202609280002), a sign that summer-quarter apparel margins were under FX/cost pressure. That is why the low end sits at -2.5.
